description: There is a large water leak near the main road and traffic is becoming difficult.
Streetlight on Block C has been off for two weeks, it's very dark at night and feels unsafe.
Garbage bin outside the mosque has been overflowing for 3 days, smell is unbearable.
Pothole on the main road near the school is getting bigger, a bike almost fell yesterday.
Sewage water is coming into our street after every rain, kids can't play outside.
Electricity pole near the park is leaning after the storm, looks like it could fall.
No streetlights working on the entire lane for a month now.
Open manhole near the bus stop, very dangerous especially at night.
Trash collection truck hasn't come to our area in over a week.
Water pipe burst outside house #45, water has been running for two days straight.
Speed breaker needed near the school gate, cars go too fast during school hours.
Broken drain cover on the footpath, someone could easily twist an ankle.
Illegal dumping of construction waste on the empty plot next to the park.
Transformer near the market making loud buzzing noise and sparking sometimes.
Road markings have completely faded at the main intersection, causing confusion.
Public park's only working streetlight also stopped working this week.
Drain overflow whenever it rains, water enters two houses on our street.
Stray dogs gathering near the garbage dump, residents are scared to walk at night.
Footpath near the hospital is broken and unusable for wheelchairs.
General feedback: the new park benches are a nice addition, thank you.
